title: Frappe ERPNext 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 6.3.0 before 15.124.0 and 16.x before 16.52.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in the customer and supplier portal list endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated attackers, including portal users or users without assigned roles, to access selling documents and RFQs without proper permission checks. Sensitive information such as valuation, margin, and bidder details can be exposed through this vulnerability.
